modified_workflow: 01 build: builder reads units.json and iterates reporting units, deleting every internal slide/note and rebuilding the 9-page public disclosure set per unit with that unit's own facts
03 render: unchanged pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 over every page
04 validate: dynamic validator checks every slide and every unit chart against the frozen expected.json

parameterized_ranges: 5 reporting units x 9 public slides per unit
per-unit native clustered-column trend chart (categories ['2024', '2025', '2026'], series 'Total emissions tCO2e') with per-unit cached 3-year values from units.json
per-unit corrected emissions inventory table (5 rows x 4 cols)
per-unit supplier engagement register table (5 rows x 4 cols)
per-unit transition action cards and board decision cards
per-unit public speaker notes on all 9 pages
preserved_parent_behavior: frozen 9-page public disclosure sequence and page titles
native clustered-column trend chart with embedded per-unit data
public style tokens (title/content background, Aptos Display bold titles, accent 22C55E, table header 166534 white bold)
public speaker notes retained on every page
correction-first workflow: internal slides and confidential notes removed before any rebuild
footer 'Public Climate Disclosure | FY2026' on every page
changed_parent_behavior: the parent's single-report deck becomes a per-unit iteration: units.json drives N x 9 pages, each with its own corrected facts
trend chart data is per-unit (3-year cached values from units.json), not the frozen 42,800 / 39,750 / 36,220 series
inventory and supplier tables carry per-unit facts

measurement_scope: Measures per-reporting-unit document generation, validation, conversion and rendering scale: units -> 9 public slides each (5 -> 45, 10 -> 90). The synthetic source presentation's own page count is NOT what this variant parses or repairs; this variant does NOT measure a larger source-PPT parse/cleanup cost. Distinguish input PPTX pages vs unit count vs expected output pages.
